headline: Oil prices jump over 2% after Yemen attack on Saudi refinery
summary: Oil prices increased following Yemen's Houthis claimed a strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, Saudi Arabia said it shot down four drones over the site.
why: The attack on Saudi oil infrastructure affects global oil supply and prices, impacting energy markets and economies dependent on oil imports.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Oil supply disruption from attack increases prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical attack on key oil infrastructure caused supply concerns, boosting crude prices.
